protocols.title: CTAB mix
protocols.description: This solution is used in the coral genomic DNA extraction protocol.  The following recipe is for 50 mL of CTAB mix. Store at -20°C.

4. Make up to a final volume of 50 mL with MilliQ water

protocols.title: 1% SDS in DNA Buffer
protocols.description: This buffer is used to stabilize samples for archiving and subsequentgenomic DNA extraction.   SDS is dissolved to a concentration of 1% (w/v) in DNAB (DNA buffer: 0.4 M NaCl + 0.05 M EDTA in MilliQ water). The buffer may need to be warmed for SDS to completely dissolve. Tissue samples are added to small aliquots of 1% SDS in DNAB and heated to 65°C for 60-90 minutes. They are then stable at room temperature and ready for extraction of genomic DNA.
protocols.steps_raw:

4. Make up to a final volume of 500 mL with MilliQ water  
reagents
